## How We Chose These Travel Tech Essentials
Travel tech fails at the worst possible moments. We prioritized extreme reliability. Battery packs that won't get confiscated by TSA, headphones with verified 25+ hour battery tests, and VPNs (like NordVPN and IPVanish) that use lightweight protocols to maintain speed on terrible 3G hotel Wi-Fi.

## Conclusion

The right tech makes travel frictionless, safe, and silent. Investing in a premium VPN secures your identity, AirTags secure your physical items, and high-end ANC headphones secure your sanity on a crowded flight.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I really need a VPN when traveling?
Yes. When you travel, you rely entirely on public, unverified networks (hotels, cafes, airports). These are prime hunting grounds for hackers "sniffing" unsecured traffic for passwords. A VPN encrypts your connection completely.

### Can a VPN help me access Netflix while abroad?
Absolutely. If you travel to Europe but want to continue a show only available on US Netflix, simply open your NordVPN app, click a US server, and Netflix will assume you are back home.

### Can I put an AirTag in my checked luggage?
Yes. Both the TSA and FAA have explicitly approved AirTags (and similar small trackers) for use in checked baggage because the batteries are too small to pose a risk.

### Can a VPN get me cheaper airline tickets?
Sometimes. Airlines use dynamic pricing based on your browsing history and location. By using a VPN to clear your cookies and change your IP address to a lower-income country (or simply a different state), you can occasionally bypass algorithmic price hikes.

### What are the TSA rules on power banks in 2026?
Typically, power banks must be carried in your carry-on luggage, never in checked baggage due to fire risks. They generally must be under 100Wh (watt-hours), though some airlines allow up to 160Wh with explicit permission.

### Why use AirFly instead of plane Bluetooth?
While some newer planes have Bluetooth, the vast majority of commercial fleets worldwide still rely on 3.5mm wired jacks for their seatback screens. An AirFly bridges that gap seamlessly.

### Is IPVanish or NordVPN better for travel?
NordVPN offers slightly faster global speeds thanks to the NordLynx protocol and better Threat Protection. IPVanish is excellent if you are traveling with a large family, as it allows unlimited simultaneous connections on one account.

### How do AirTags work if they don't have GPS?
AirTags ping a secure Bluetooth signal that can be detected by ANY nearby iPhone on the "Find My" network. That other iPhone then securely and anonymously uploads the location to the cloud for you to see. In crowded places like airports, they update almost instantly.
